identity.retryPolicy: Transport failures (timeout (180s), network error, HTTP 408/409/429/5xx, unreadable API response with 5xx, incomplete or missing output) are retried up to 4 attempts per turn with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After and provider reset headers. Live calls use a 5-second minimum pace, increasing automatically to stay under 80% of a reported token/minute limit, and live episodes cool down by 30 seconds; every attempt and sanitized rate-limit header is recorded. Exhausted HTTP 429 retries interrupt the batch as infrastructure rather than counting as model failure. Invalid model output (unparseable JSON, schema violation, refusal) is not retried or repaired: it is recorded as an invalid response and terminates the episode as unsolved. A valid direction that is visibly blocked is not retried or repaired: it is executed as a blocked move, counts as a wall hit, consumes the turn, and the episode continues.

aiTransport.policy: Provider requests use the shared Vercel AI SDK transport with structured output. SDK retries are disabled; Echo Maze owns every retry, pacing delay, and attempt record.

identity.coordinateSystem: Walker-relative coordinates start at (0,0). A successful move right changes x by +1, left by -1, up by +1, down by -1. A blocked move changes nothing. The Walker never receives absolute maze rows/columns.
identity.hiddenStatePolicy: The prompt receives only the narrow observation DTO (open/blocked directions, corridor sightlines, per-visible-cell open directions and isExit flag, last action/result) plus the current run's conversation. No full maze, no exit coordinates, no seed, no optimal route, no unseen cells, and no spectator state may enter the prompt.

payload.notes: Start (0,0). Open: right, down. Blocked: up, left. Sightline right: corridor length 3, at dist3 cell opens down/left (so there's a junction at (3,0)). Down: cell at (0,-1) opens up/left. Will explore right first toward junction.

At (1,0) after moving right from start. Corridor continues right: (2,0) then junction at (3,0) opens down/left. Left leads back to start (0,0), which opens down. Up/down blocked here. Head right toward junction.

At (2,0). Up/down blocked, open left/right. Sightline right: dist1 cell (3,0) opens down/left (junction). Sightline left: dist1 (1,0) opens right/down, dist2 (0,0) opens right/down. So (1,0) and (0,0) both connect down. Continue right to junction at (3,0), then can go down there.
At (3,0) junction. Open down/left; up/right blocked. Came from left. Down corridor: (3,-1) opens up/down/left, (3,-2) up/down, (3,-3) up/left. Choose down to explore new branch.

At (3,-1). Open up/down/left, right blocked. Up returns to junction (3,0). Down continues to (3,-2) then (3,-3) opening left. Left is new: (2,-1) opens right/left, (1,-1) opens right/down. Exploring left branch next.
At (2,-1): open left/right; up/down blocked. Came from (3,-1). Left leads to (1,-1), which opens right/down, so continue left to reach a new downward branch. Need eventually explore that branch.

At (1,-1): open right/down, blocked up/left. Right returns to (2,-1) which was a dead-endish corridor (came from there). Down is new: corridor (1,-2),(1,-3),(1,-4) each open up/down, then (1,-5) opens up/left (turn at bottom). Going down to explore this branch.
At (1,-2). Open up/down; right/left blocked. Down corridor continues: (1,-3),(1,-4) open up/down, (1,-5) opens up/left. Continue down to explore bottom turn; up returns to (1,-1).

At (1,-3). Open up/down; left/right blocked. Up returns to (1,-2). Down corridor continues: (1,-4) opens up/down, then (1,-5) opens up/left (bottom turn). Continue down to explore the left branch at (1,-5).
At (1,-4). Open up/down; right/left blocked. Up returns toward (1,-3). Down leads to (1,-5), which opens up/left, so continue down to explore the left turn at the bottom branch.
At (1,-5). Open up/left; blocked right/down. Up returns to (1,-4). Left leads to (0,-5) which opens up/right. Take left to explore new branch; (0,-5) then opens up, likely a corridor turning north.

At (0,-5) after moving left from (1,-5). Open up/right; down/left blocked. Came from right. Up is new: sightline up dist1 (0,-4) opens up/down, dist2 (0,-3) opens down/left — wait, consistent with a north corridor turning. Going up to explore this vertical branch.
